exclusions.en: Standard non-commercial entry only; tattoo, owner timing, certificate model, country overlays and other exceptions require review.
exclusions.zh-CN: 仅普通非商业入境；纹身、主人时间关系、证书版本、成员国叠加和其他例外待核。

scope_note.en: Readable tattoo applied before 3 July 2011 needs separate identification review.
scope_note.zh-CN: 2011年7月3日前施加且清晰可读纹身，需另核身份识别分支。

summary.en: Microchip identification or reading must not follow rabies vaccination.
